scope: portable incremental history gate: local same-refs comparison of the uncached and incremental modes

environment.note: The portable cache fingerprint includes the Python version, so the CI cache is built and reused by CI's own interpreter.

new_cases: cold then warm resumes without reading cached bytes
new commit scanned and failed run does not save the cache
cached .part and manifest bytes still read for boundary order
portable cache rejected for another repository
corrupted store falls back to a full scan
incremental requires an explicit cache file and refuses mixed modes

limits: Local observation of one cold and one warm run; CI runner timings and cross-run cache hits are not measured here and must be confirmed by the post-merge push run.
Skipped object bytes are trusted through Git content addressing plus git fsck; this is not a defence against an administrator who rewrites the repository or its hooks.
The portable cache is not a publication attestation: publication_evidence stays false and release, bundle, weekly schedule and explicit --all-history remain uncached full scans.
Remote branch protection and required status checks are separate platform settings and were not verified.
private_evidence: LOCALAPPDATA/ComfyUI-LoRA-Imports and the interactive session logs; the raw report JSON stays outside Git
